verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include a first-party API reference section, with pages for Custom Integration Push APIs / Integration Monitoring and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs. The evidence shows only page titles, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404, so interactivity is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
